text:
maria (HW Partnerships): Quick sync — proposing a 10-day mini pilot with NovaEdge to validate perf/W improvements from their micro-kernel change. Aim: reproducible matrix we can cite in a marketplace 'pilot' card, and decide on a joint blog/announce.
linh (NovaEdge): We can do it. We'll hand over 3 test nodes (SXM-ish) and an image with kernel patch NVX-7. Timeline: readiness by Mon.
aj (Perf Eng): Nice. For clarity: target model redwood/pyxis-7b-quant, seqs 64/256, batch 1/8, short-run latency checks and longer 20m steady-state. We'll measure energy_j (per-sample joules) + tokens/s.
sam (Runtime): I'll add a runtime flag --kernel-hint=nvx7 which forces the kernel variant selection; toggleable at runtime via RPC. Need partner kernel binary and a small smoke script.
tess (Product): Please mark anything public as "pilot data" and include test conditions. Also agree embargo until both legal and product signoff.
maria (HW Partnerships): Scope draft: runs = [20m steady, 5m latency], seqs=[64,256], batches=[1,8], repeats=3, metrics=energy_j,tokens_per_s,p95_ms,cpu_temp_c,kernel_tag. Responsible: NovaEdge runs, AJ ingests, Sam verifies runtime toggles, Maria coordinates PR.
linh (NovaEdge): We'll provide: image link, kernel tag NVX-7, kernel config snippet (NVX_PREFETCH=Y, SCHED_HINT=throughput), and PDU telemetry (per-node watts). We'll send creds via vault.
aj (Perf Eng): Minimal CSV header for ingestion: timestamp,model,seq_len,batch,energy_j,tokens_per_s,p95_ms,cpu_temp_c,kernel_tag,run_uuid. Use that exact header pls.
benchbot: benchbot: created job -> bench/novaedge/4312345678-mini-pilot, cluster=partner-dev, nodes=3, out=s3://redwood-partners/novaedge/4312345678/mini-summary.json
sam (Runtime): Smoke command for partner to run after image boot:
```
./mini_bench --model redwood/pyxis-7b-quant --seq 256 --batch 8 --duration 300 --profile energy,latency --kernel-hint nvx7 --out mini_summary.json
```
linh (NovaEdge): Running smoke now, will include raw perf counters and /sys/kernel/config for trace. Also attaching a short README for how we built NVX-7.
aj (Perf Eng): After smoke, we'll run the full matrix next day. For each cell: 3 runs, report median tokens/s and median energy_j; compute perf/W proxy = tokens_per_s / (energy_j/sec) — make sure units align.
tess (Product): Timeline: smoke Mon, full matrix Tue-Wed, ingest+analysis Thu, internal review Fri. Draft marketplace blurb ready by Thu EOD.
maria (HW Partnerships): Also let's capture a short note about kernel authorship that NovaEdge can approve for the joint blurb. Linh, sound good?
linh (NovaEdge): Yes, include a 1-paragraph technical blurb and attribution. Happy to co-author.
benchbot: benchbot: smoke job completed -> s3://redwood-partners/novaedge/4312345678/mini-summary.json (md5: e3b0c44298fc1c149afbf4c8996fb924)
aj (Perf Eng): Pulled smoke artifacts. Preliminary: ~9% uplift tokens/s with NVX-7 and ~7% lower energy_j for seq=256,batch=8. Need full sweep to confirm stability.
sam (Runtime): No runtime regressions on our side. The kernel toggle worked; scheduled the matrix runs for Tue 02:00 UTC.
maria (HW Partnerships): Great. Next steps: Linh to push kernel binary + vault creds, AJ to start matrix and upload to S3, Sam to keep toggle live, Tess draft blurb. Keep updates here. :rocket:
